Compatibility arguments for the source pipeline

Source: R/pipeline_options.R
pipeline_compatibility.Rd

run_one_source() accepts named arguments from the ungrouped interface through .... New calls can use the option constructors described in pipeline_options.

Grouped and direct arguments

Settings documented by an option constructor may also be supplied directly. For example, concept_name = "heart_rate" and concepts = concept_options(concept_name = "heart_rate") specify the same setting. Supplying both forms raises an error. Unknown argument names are rejected. Layer selection is also accepted directly, for example run_one_source("mimic_iii", stages = "run_concepts", layers = "flat").

Name arguments after src_name, db_name, and base_dir when updating a positional call. Option-group names must be exact; cohort remains a cohort selection setting and is not an abbreviation for cohort_selection.

Stage switches

The following switches affect default stage selection when stages = NULL. An explicit stages vector determines which stages run.

run_cohort_annotations

Logical or NULL. TRUE selects cohort annotations in place of cohort information. NULL resolves to FALSE.

run_comorbidities, run_iss

Logical or NULL. NULL enables these stages for the scid profile and disables them for other profiles. Explicit values override that default.

run_external

Logical, default FALSE. Enables the separate external-SQL stage. It does not control the external layer inside run_concepts; use concept_options(layers = ...) for layer selection.

Retired arguments

delete_source_csv = FALSE is accepted. delete_source_csv = TRUE raises an error; raw source files are not deleted by the pipeline.

See also

run_one_source(), pipeline_options
